title: RubricOpt: Self-Revision of Semantic Rubrics for Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model's failures can reveal gaps in the behavioral criteria guiding its training. We introduce RubricOpt, a framework that lets a policy revise these criteria within preference optimization. The policy diagnoses its own rubric-free outputs, retains requirements already covered by the rubric, and edits clauses that leave recurring failures unaddressed. A shared semantic representation connects task demands, preference-data contrasts, and rubric clauses, while a deterministic gate checks evidence references and fixed semantic anchors. The rubric then guides Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) during training, with preference pairs, labels, and the objective held fixed, and is removed at evaluation. Our analysis relates the local effect on rubric-free success to semantic alignment and a residual beyond the measured factors. Experiments on capability and open-ended generation benchmarks show that rubric conditioning can improve outcomes o

translated_title: RubricOpt：面向偏好优化的语义评估准则自我修订框架
translated_abstract: 模型的失败可以揭示其训练所依据的行为准则中存在的缺口。我们提出了RubricOpt，一个让策略在偏好优化过程中修订这些准则的框架。该策略对自身在无准则条件下的输出进行诊断，保留准则中已经覆盖的要求，并编辑那些未能解决反复出现失败的条款。一个共享的语义表示将任务需求、偏好数据对比和准则条款连接起来，同时一个确定性门控机制用于检查证据引用和固定的语义锚点。在训练期间，该准则引导直接偏好优化（DPO），而偏好对、标签和目标函数保持不变，并在评估时被移除。我们的分析将无准则条件成功率的局部效应与语义对齐以及超出所测量因素的残差联系起来。在能力型与开放式生成基准上的实验表明，准则条件化可以改善结果。
tldr: RubricOpt提出了一种让模型在偏好优化过程中自我修订语义评估准则的框架，通过诊断自身输出、编辑准则条款并以固定偏好数据引导DPO训练，从而提升模型在能力型与开放式生成任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: RubricOpt is a framework that enables a policy to self-revise semantic rubrics during preference optimization by diagnosing its own outputs and editing rubric clauses, which then guide DPO training with fixed preference data and improve performance on capability and open-ended generation benchmarks.
